== Update, February 10, 2026 ==

=== 60/60 Exploit ===
A bug in the [[PvP Equipment]] panel allowed for non-PvP items to be [[customize]]d, and in some cases would apply item [[Upgrade component|upgrades]] that were incompatible with the customized item. This resulted in items being created that couldn't be obtained through natural play (this includes what the community refers to as [[60/60]] items). A previous update fixed the bug, and today's update removes invalid item upgrades from some items previously created via the bug.
